# S0 recon (generated by eval/s0_recon.py from the live repo)

## Pipeline as deployed
- **PDF parsing**: PyMuPDF 1.26.7 `page.get_text("text")`, one Document per non-empty page (`backend/ingestion.py`); page text cleaned by `chunking._clean_text` (whitespace, de-hyphenation). No layout/column/table handling, ligatures (e.g. "veriﬁcation") are kept as extracted.
- **Chunker**: LangChain `RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter`, chunk_size=512, chunk_overlap=128 chars (25%), length=len, separators `['\n\n', '\n', '. ', '? ', '! ', '; ', ', ', ' ', '']`; chunks never cross pages.
- **Embedder**: `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` (sentence-transformers 5.6.1), L2-normalised, 384-d, max_seq_length 256 tokens.
- **Vector store**: ChromaDB 0.5.23, metric `cosine` (HNSW).
- **Retrieval used by the app** (`pipeline.query`): hybrid = dense top-30 + BM25Okapi top-30 -> RRF (k=60) -> top-20 -> FlashRank -> source-diversity round-robin -> top-10 sent to the LLM.
- **`run_eval.py --mode dense-only`**: dense top-20 -> FlashRank (+ diversity) -> top-10. So the README's "Dense-Only" row is **dense+FlashRank**, not plain dense; its "Hybrid" row is the full production pipeline (hybrid + FlashRank).
- **FlashRank**: flashrank 0.2.10, `Ranker()` default model `ms-marco-TinyBERT-L-2-v2`, max_length 512.
- **Answer model**: `openai/gpt-oss-20b` on Groq, temperature 0.4, max_tokens 3072; production system prompt in `backend/generation.py`.
- **Semantic cache** (SQLite, similarity >= 0.92) sits in front of the pipeline; run_eval clears it per query.
- **Index on disk**: chroma_db holds the OLD corpus (20 templated stub PDFs of ~600 characters each + `Attention Is All You Need`), 145 chunks. `uploads/` now holds 23 real papers (2,085,912 chars of cleaned text); the benchmark indexes them in memory and does not touch chroma_db.

## Existing RAGAS script (`run_eval.py`)
- Metrics: faithfulness, answer_relevancy, context_precision, context_recall (legacy RAGAS API). Judge LLM: `ChatGroq(model=GROQ_MODEL, temperature=0, max_tokens=2048)`; embeddings MiniLM.
- Contexts for RAGAS are **re-retrieved separately** from the answer call (not the exact chunks the LLM saw).
- Test set: `eval/test_set.json`, 21 auto-generated Q&A pairs, all auto-approved, generated from the OLD stub corpus (`generate_testset.py`).

## Provenance of "+25% Context Precision on 21 queries"
- **Not found anywhere in the repo.** Searched: README, `eval/*`, `logs/*`, full git history (`git log -S`).
- The only before/after table is in `README.md` (added in commit 115e8b5, 2026-08-25): Context Precision 0.869 -> 0.9167 = **+0.0477 absolute = +5.5% relative** (Context Recall +5.3% relative; Faithfulness and Answer Relevancy unchanged). That is "dense+FlashRank vs hybrid+FlashRank", not dense vs dense+FlashRank.
- The only saved run (`eval/eval_runs.json`, 1 run): mode `dense-only`, 21 questions, **all four RAGAS scores are None** (the RAGAS evaluation failed; the run took 2096.45 s). `eval_results.md` shows N/A.
- RAGAS judge at the time of that saved run (2026-08-01): `GROQ_MODEL` = `llama-3.3-70b-versatile` (config unchanged 2026-06-20 -> 2026-08-25). The README numbers have no saved run behind them; if they were produced between 2026-08-25 and 2026-08-28 the judge would have been `qwen/qwen3-27b` (inference from git dates, not verifiable).
- Conclusion: "+25%" is not supported by any artifact in this repo; the closest recorded figure is +5.5% relative (+4.8 points absolute) on a different comparison.

## Code fixes made alongside (default behaviour unchanged)
- `backend/config.py`: env-var switches (RAG_CHUNK_SIZE, RAG_CHUNK_OVERLAP, RAG_EMBEDDING_MODEL, RAG_COLLECTION, RAG_POOL, RAG_POOL_DENSE, RAG_POOL_BM25, RAG_TOP_K, RAG_RERANK) with the old values as defaults.
- `backend/pipeline.py`: honours `RAG_RERANK=0`; the Langfuse generation span no longer hard-codes `qwen/qwen3-27b` (it reported the wrong model once `GROQ_MODEL` changed to `openai/gpt-oss-20b`).
